summary_ja: 文部科学省の2026年自己点検報告は、HPCI共通窓口が開始以来約29,800件の問合せ（技術支援約11,100件）を扱い、FY2024までの高度化支援が354件、うち産業利用120件、GPU搭載機支援16件だったとしています。利用前相談103件のうち30件が申請に至り、伴走型支援はFY2024まで19件、FY2025開始の富岳全系規模支援は7件すべて目標実行を完走しました。支援対象ではFY2022–2024の高速化が平均約3.9倍、中央値2.1倍ですが、選定済み案件の実績であり一般的な期待値ではありません。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: MEXT's 2026 self-review reports about 29,800 inquiries handled by the HPCI common desk since launch, including about 11,100 technical-support inquiries. By FY2024 there had been 354 advanced-support cases, including 120 industrial cases and 16 cases on GPU-equipped systems. Thirty of 103 pre-use consultations led to applications, 19 hands-on support cases were delivered by FY2024, and all seven supported whole-system Fugaku executions met their execution goals. Supported cases in FY2022–FY2024 recorded about 3.9x mean and 2.1x median speedup, but this selected population is not a general forecast. Consensus is incomplete.

items.name_ja: 共通窓口・高度化・伴走型支援の規模
items.name_en: Scale of common-desk, advanced, and hands-on support
items.statement_ja: HPCI共通窓口は事業開始から約29,800件の問合せを受け、うち約11,100件が技術支援でした。FY2024までの高度化支援は354件で、富岳以外のHPCI資源49件、産業利用120件、GPU搭載機16件を含みます。利用前相談103件のうち30件が課題申請に至り、FY2021開始の伴走型支援はFY2024まで19件でした。件数は需要規模を示しますが、解決率、応答時間、要員負荷は示しません。
items.statement_en: The HPCI common desk received about 29,800 inquiries since program launch, including about 11,100 technical-support inquiries. The 354 advanced-support cases through FY2024 included 49 on non-Fugaku HPCI resources, 120 industrial cases, and 16 involving GPU-equipped systems. Thirty of 103 pre-use consultations led to project applications, and hands-on support launched in FY2021 reached 19 cases by FY2024. Counts indicate demand scale but not resolution rate, response time, or staffing load.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 次期運営では問い合わせ総数だけでなく、分野・システム・難度別の解決時間、再問い合わせ、申請・成果への転換を測る必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Successor operations should measure resolution time, recurrence, and conversion to applications and outcomes by field, system, and complexity, not only inquiry volume.
adoption_conditions_ja: 問い合わせと支援案件の定義・重複・期間を固定する。
GPU・産業・初心者等の重複区分を明示する。
件数増を品質向上と同一視しない。
adoption_conditions_en: Pin definitions, overlap rules, and periods for inquiries and support cases.
Disclose overlap among GPU, industry, novice, and other segments.
Do not equate higher volume with higher quality.

items.name_ja: 全系実行完走と支援対象の高速化
items.name_en: Whole-system completion and speedup among supported cases
items.statement_ja: FY2025開始の富岳全系規模支援は報告時点まで7件を支援し、目標としたすべての実行が完走しました。FY2022–FY2024の性能改善支援では、支援対象アプリの高速化率が平均約3.9倍、中央値2.1倍と報告されています。対象選定、基準版、測定条件、失敗例、分布は示されないため、次期システムや未支援案件の期待高速化率には使えません。
items.statement_en: Whole-system Fugaku support launched in FY2025 had assisted seven executions by the report date, and every targeted execution completed. Performance-improvement support in FY2022–FY2024 reported mean speedup of about 3.9x and median of 2.1x among supported applications. Selection, baselines, measurement conditions, failed cases, and distribution are not given, so these values cannot forecast successor systems or unsupported workloads.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 支援の価値は平均高速化だけでなく、完走率、成果到達、移植期間、再利用可能な改善、要員時間で評価すべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Support value should be evaluated through completion, outcome attainment, porting time, reusable improvements, and staff effort in addition to mean speedup.
adoption_conditions_ja: 案件ごとの基準・改善後時間、資源、精度、要員時間を保存する。
平均と中央値に加えて分布と不成功案件を開示する。
支援実績を将来機の性能係数に転用しない。
adoption_conditions_en: Preserve baseline and improved time, resources, accuracy, and staff effort per case.
Report distributions and unsuccessful cases alongside mean and median.
Do not reuse support outcomes as successor-system performance multipliers.
